detail.longDescription: thinksynth ~ Modular Synth & Algorthmic Composition thinksynth builds sounds out of a graph of DSP nodes, oscillators, filters, envelopes, delays and arithmetic; described in a small language and rendered in real time. Patches assign those graphs to MIDI channels, so one instrument can layer several voices. https:// audio-file.org/2026/10/10/thin ksynth-modular-synth-algorthmic-composition/
